title: TapTrack
description: A web-based student attendance system utilizing QR and RFID technology alongside real-time WhatsApp notifications. Implemented as a thesis project at SMK TI Dwiguna Depok.

title: EduPay
description: A web-based school tuition (SPP) management system featuring comprehensive fee tracking, automated financial reporting, and seamless WhatsApp integration for instant receipts and payment reminders.

title: SmartCBT
description: A secure Computer-Based Testing (CBT) platform designed for educational institutions. It features advanced question banks, automated grading, precise timer controls, and in-depth performance analytics.

title: InternTrack
description: A web-based internship (PKL) monitoring platform bridging schools and industry partners. Key features include digital daily logbooks, location-based attendance tracking, streamlined supervisor approvals, and automated reporting.

title: EduSys
description: An integrated educational Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system centralizing academic, administrative, and financial operations. It includes dedicated modules for student data management, HR, curriculum planning, and asset tracking.

title: OmniPOS
description: A versatile Point of Sale (POS) system offering specialized modules for laundries, pharmacies, and clinics. Features include real-time inventory tracking, secure transaction processing, and comprehensive sales reporting.
